scope: Isolated paginated Cloud bootstrap/change service and atomic local cursor/head application on Node SQLite and Chrome IndexedDB with synthetic loopback HTTP identity; not app, Cognito, DynamoDB, live push, Safari/iPhone, power-loss or public acceptance
serverPullTests: catches creates, edits and purges during bootstrap and keeps a stable change upper bound
ends pages at the byte budget without skipping head keys or change sequences
rejects foreign, tampered, wrong-purpose, expired and rotated-key cursors
detects physical change gaps without advancing across the missing sequence
rejects logically expired needed changes even while the checkpoint and physical row remain
withholds a new round when entitlement is revoked during HMAC signing
remainingGates: Production cursor keys and authenticated account/session integration
DynamoDB pagination/conditional transactions and hosting/cost gates
Native Rust and production IndexedDB repository integration with migrations and immediate body/index deletion
Live push/reconnect scheduler and truthful sync/conflict UI
Restored-server absence handling, Safari/iPhone and public performance/security acceptance
